d: A missing dog leads exes Becca and Max on a search that brings back fond memories of Christmas pasts that they spent together.
A TV chef is divinely inspired to take over her late aunt's charity with help from a new friend and handsome neighbor.
Looking to escape his royal life, a dashing prince comes to the United States to start a business in a small town in upstate New York and winds up falling for a former Olympic ice skater.
Ivy Donaldson struggles with her mom's shadow, Muriel, the Christmas darling of Icicle Falls. She is now separated from her husband Rob and tries her best with her daughter.
Prompted by their youngest granddaughter, four generations of women celebrate Christmas and family in the style of the 40s, 60s, 90s, and today.
A retired ballerina finds unexpected romance while working with a visiting team of royal ambassadors to stage the holiday season's performance of "The Nutcracker."

t: Let's Meet Again on Christmas Eve
d: Two college sweethearts reconnect while coordinating a wedding just in time for the holidays.
The sudden arrival of Lucas' mother makes Elizabeth more than a little nervous; Lee injures his back; a newcomer's arrival causes Rosemary to reflect on what she wants in life.
Ty struggles with control issues when his mom stops by for an unexpected visit, in hopes of bonding with her granddaughter.
The family supports Georgie as she decides whether to face a ghost from her past.
Tim steps up Jade's training regimen when a new competitor shows up.

A real estate executive travels to Alaska during the holidays to acquire a bed-and-breakfast, only to discover it's owned by her ex. She's soon falling in love with the town and quite possibly him all over again.

Identical twins Alice and Lacey are mistaken for each other on a retreat. They decide to go with it just for the trip, soon they realize that they may have been wrong about who and what they needed in their lives all along.
